messages:
tj: Heads-up — we need a follow-up on eviction heuristics after the canary. Observed weird token debt spikes on low-priority tenants.
sarah: saw that. I think probes are getting misclassified as abuse because of short-burst pattern.
liam: can you paste a small trace?
sarah: snippet: 
```
route=/generate model=gpt-small tokens=1024 latency_ms=1200 burst=8
client_meta.probe=true
```
liam: ah, probe flag sometimes missing. When probe not flagged we treat it as normal traffic and probation triggers.
maria: we should make probation idempotent and add a token-escrow so we don't evict on transient bursts. proposal: `admit.probation.window_ms = 60000` and `admit.probation.escrow_tokens = 500`
tj: +1 to escrow. Also add decay instead of hard revoke: `quota.decay_rate = 0.0005` so tenant recovers linearly.
sarah: concern: escrow adds memory overhead if we track per-session escrow. Maybe keep escrow per-tenant with TTL.
liam: implementation idea — probation is two-phase: soft-probation (throttle to 50% with escrow) then hard-evict after sustained violation (x retries). That way normal users hit minor latency, not full failure.
maria: also fingerprint probes by TLS fingerprint + route pattern. We can add `probe_signature` to token accounting to avoid false positives.
tj: what about gaming? attackers could mark probe flag true. Need a trust boundary: only internal probing infra can set `client_meta.probe=true` or sign the probe header.
sarah: agree. only signed probes accepted. Otherwise probe flag ignored at edge gateway.
liam: telemetry question — add `probation.start_reason` tag and emit metric `tenant.probation.duration` so we can monitor regressions.
maria: ops-bot: can you create a canary with soft-probation enabled for 2% of tenants and `escrow_tokens=250`?
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: canary group `probation-soft-02` starting 1702001200 UTC, rollout 10% -> 100% over 1h. Link: https://deploy.redwood/probation-soft-02 :rocket:
 tj: thanks. follow-ups: (1) `escrow_tokens` TTL semantics doc (maria), (2) probe signing spec (sarah), (3) metric dashboard for `probation.*` (liam). I'll own the rollout policy.
sarah: I'll draft probe signing RFC today and tag on threat model.
maria: drafting escrow TTL doc now, will share PR.
liam: I'll wire up dashboards and alert thresholds (`probation.rate > 0.5% / 5m` triggers paged on weekdays).
tj: estimated rollback trigger: if 95th latency increases > 15% for probed routes or token cost delta > 20% for canary group.
sarah: sounds safe. Also add `soft-probation` toggle per-region. multi-region rollouts need to be independent.
maria: noted. Will update the canary config.
tj: OK closing — sync tomorrow 10am to review canary telemetry. :thumbsup:
